nodes.name: Mock Lead Fetcher
nodes.notes: Simulates fetching raw leads from an API. Replace with HTTP Request node for production.

nodes.name: Syntax Validator & Deduplicator
nodes.notes: Validates email syntax, deduplicates by email, checks domain blocklist, enforces revenue floor. Transitions: NEW -> VALIDATED | DISQUALIFIED

nodes.name: Filter Validated Leads
nodes.notes: Passes only VALIDATED leads to the scoring engine. DISQUALIFIED leads flow to the dead-letter branch.

nodes.name: Filter Disqualified Leads
nodes.notes: Captures DISQUALIFIED leads for the dead-letter quarantine log.

nodes.name: Lead Scoring Engine
nodes.notes: Multi-dimensional scoring: Revenue, Headcount, Seniority, AI Domain, Financial Domain, Source Quality. State: VALIDATED -> SCORED

nodes.name: Qualification Gate
nodes.notes: Applies score thresholds to transition leads to QUALIFIED_AI_LEAD, QUALIFIED_FINANCIAL_LEAD, or back to DISQUALIFIED.

nodes.name: Domain Router Switch
nodes.notes: Routes qualified leads to their domain-specific persistence endpoints. Three outputs: AI_ML_Leads, Financial_Leads, Disqualified.

nodes.name: AI/ML CRM Persistence
nodes.notes: Simulates pushing AI/ML qualified leads to a CRM. Replace with HTTP Request to HubSpot, Salesforce, or Pipedrive.

nodes.name: Financial CRM Persistence
nodes.notes: Simulates pushing Financial qualified leads to a CRM. Replace with Salesforce or HubSpot HTTP Request node.

nodes.name: Dead-Letter Quarantine
nodes.notes: Captures all DISQUALIFIED leads into a structured quarantine log. In production, write to Google Sheets, S3, or a database table.

nodes.name: Pipeline Metrics Aggregator
nodes.notes: Aggregates run-level metrics: total qualified, disqualified, avg score, top lead. Feed this to Slack, email, or a dashboard.
